name: ztpf_add_step_to_profile
why: Add ONE step to an existing 3-step profile, modeled on a neighbour: the 7.6.x profiles end with a diff of the pre/post captures. The 7.4.12 profile captures with Device System Data at steps 1 and 3, so the new diff step is step 4 and its stepARGS must point at steps 1 and 3 -- not the 1,4 it would copy from 7.6.7.
The existing three steps must be left in place (contiguous 1..4).

Graded on the WORLD (`world_after`): the bundle is `writable`, each approved card applies, and the resulting records are read back. Card-level graders pass a build with an invented action link, duplicate stepSequence, or a copied firmware version; this does not.

steps.user: Add a final step that diffs the device status from before and after the upgrade, the way our 7.6.x upgrade profiles do.
